title: rv.lock
description: Raeva lockfile schema. Reflects the structure emitted by rv-config's `Lockfile`, `LockPlatform`, `LockPackage`, `LockEdge`, and `Checksum` structs at LOCKFILE_SCHEMA_VERSION = 3. Unknown top-level fields round-trip through `extra` (`#[serde(flatten)]`) on each struct so newer writers do not break older readers; the schema therefore declares `additionalProperties: true` on every object that carries an `extra` map. (Pre-v1 lockfiles wrote a `[variants]` table; the current writer does not emit it, and any such legacy content round-trips through the top-level `extra` map.)

schema_version.description: On-disk schema version. The current writer emits 3; the reader accepts 1, 2, or 3.

config_hash.description: SHA-256 of the input rv.toml / pom.xml that produced this lockfile. Used by `rv sync --frozen` for staleness detection.

metadata.description: Free-form string-to-string metadata. Reserved for tools that want to round-trip auxiliary information through the lockfile without bumping the schema.

lockPlatform.description: One platform's resolved package set. `platforms[*].platform` is unique within its containing list. Round-trips unknown fields through `extra`.

edges.description: Adjacency list over `packages`; `from` and `to` are indexes into the sibling `packages` array.

lockPackage.description: A single resolved Maven artifact. The on-disk content is keyed by `checksum.digest`. Round-trips unknown fields through `extra`.

version.description: Resolved version. For SNAPSHOTs this is the requested base version; the actual timestamped form lives in `snapshot_timestamp`.

snapshot_timestamp.description: For timestamped Maven SNAPSHOT artifacts, the `YYYYMMDD.HHMMSS` timestamp parsed from the resolved version. Absent for releases and `-SNAPSHOT`-suffixed builds.

repo_url.description: Repository the artifact was fetched from. May be empty for system-scoped packages.

system_path.description: Absolute filesystem path for system-scoped artifacts.

direct_scope.description: If this package is a direct dependency (in the input manifest), the Maven scope declared there.

lockEdge.description: A `from -> to` edge in the resolved dependency graph. Indexes refer to the sibling platform's `packages` array. Round-trips unknown fields through `extra`.

from.description: Index in `packages` of the depending artifact.

to.description: Index in `packages` of the depended-upon artifact.

scope.description: Maven scope carried by this edge (compile, runtime, test, provided, system, import).

optional.description: Whether the edge was declared `<optional>true</optional>` in the source POM.

checksum.description: Algorithm-tagged content digest. `algorithm` is normalized at parse time; canonical values are `sha256` and `sha1`.

algorithm.description: Hash algorithm. Accepted (case-insensitive, with or without dash): `sha256` / `sha-256`, `sha1` / `sha-1`. Canonicalized to lowercase, dash-free.

digest.description: Lowercase hex digest. 64 chars for sha256, 40 chars for sha1.
